description: Generate React/Vue file sets or a standalone static HTML document from a validated UiSchema. Use it when a schema already exists; use design_compose instead to choose a layout or pipeline_run to compose, validate, render and generate together. Returns versioned artifacts, exact dependencies, required domain handlers and validationReceipt. Supply schema or schemaRef before its 30-minute expiry. profile selects draft/build/release; build performs static checks, while release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it. options.output selects component/application; options.payloadMode:file returns file references, as does oversized output unless inline. Domain actions require consumer handlers. React and Vue shadcn mappings support components, screen apps and workflow apps. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#code_generate; full schema: oods://schemas/code_generate.input.json.
